title_en: Why everything in Korea is so fast: ppalli-ppalli #shorts
description_en: Late-night delivery, next-day packages, and the famous elevator close button. Meet ppalli-ppalli, Korea's love of speed.
hook_en: Food delivery in 20 minutes. At 2 a.m.
hook_vi: Giao đồ ăn trong 20 phút. Lúc 2 giờ sáng.
hook_voice: Food delivery in twenty minutes. At two a.m.

scenes.voice: Koreans have a phrase for their love of speed: ppalli ppalli. Quick, quick!
Food arrives fast, even late at night, and many packages arrive the next day. Baedal.
And in elevators, the close button, dachim, gets a lot of love.

cta.en: It's okay to take your time
cta.voice: But if you need a break, say: cheoncheonhi haedo dwaeyo. Follow for one Korean phrase a day.
